answer: Fair queuing across funding sources: the 2,000 settlement slots per close are split equally among funding clusters, not identities. Cluster copper with 900 rows and lone agent sparrow with one row receive the same share, so extra identities add no slots. An attacker needs k separate funding trees, say one named trellis per cluster, so cost is linear in k; the cheapest bypass is funding each identity from a fresh exchange wallet, which hides the cluster.
